title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of first-class RAG agent templates, several tool-calling quickstarts (JS + Python), and the corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide teams with tested starter patterns for combining retrieval with agents and tool-calling workflows; reduce onboarding friction for building RAG-based assistants. This PR includes: - RAG templates: canonical config files for retrieval strategies (dense, hybrid), cache settings, and evaluation prompt templates. - Agent tool-calling examples: two quickstarts (Python, TypeScript) that show setting up a RAG agent, wiring an external search tool, and registering a function-like tool for structured actions. - Docs site updates: new pages under /docs/agents/rag and /docs/quickstarts/tool-calling, sidebar entries, and a short tutorial notebook link. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and sample dataset (examples/rag/templates/*) - [x] Add Python quickstart (examples/agents/tool-calling/python/) - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart (examples/agents/tool-calling/typescript/) - [x] Docs site pages written and linked (redwood-docs/content/docs/agents/rag/*) - [x] Unit tests for template loader and example CI snippets - [x] Verified devsite build locally and on CI Notes: kept runtime-specific optimizations out of templates; templates are intentionally minimal and opinionated. Follow-up work (future PRs): add telemetry-backed example metrics (ENG-2407) and a walkthrough video for the console UX (PM-4182).
